domain_note: 200 is a replenishment search budget, not a claimed full finite domain size. The bounded domain consists of three matrices, dimensions 2 through 4, at most 36 inspected entries, fixed source role mix and offdiagonal count. Search exhaustion remains an explicit shortage.
